goals.objective: Improve /Users/shinyoohag/Desktop/frametrace gui/evidence-viewer with focused code changes. Preserve the existing dirty worktree and do not revert unrelated changes. Code changes are done by Codex. GUI verification must use agbrowse: start a local static server, run agbrowse start --headed, navigate to the local GUI, and capture agbrowse snapshot, screenshot, and console evidence. Verify mobile 375, tablet 768, and desktop 1280 for overflow, buttons, status display, and report flow. Final report must include changed files, verification commands, screenshot paths, and remaining risk.

successCriteria.scenario: Desktop headed agbrowse happy path: run python3 -m http.server 4181 --directory gui/evidence-viewer, run agbrowse start --headed, agbrowse navigate http://127.0.0.1:4181/index.html, agbrowse resize 1280 900, then capture agbrowse snapshot --interactive, agbrowse screenshot --json, and agbrowse console --json. PASS iff desktop screenshot shows the viewer, candidate list, status display, and report/export flow without overlapping text; snapshot exposes usable review buttons; console has no page errors.

successCriteria.scenario: Responsive headed agbrowse edge path: with the same local server and headed agbrowse browser, run agbrowse resize 375 900 and 768 900, reload/navigate as needed, then for each viewport capture agbrowse snapshot --interactive, agbrowse screenshot --json, agbrowse console --json, and agbrowse evaluate JSON for scrollWidth/clientWidth plus key button/status/report-flow visibility.
